name: 棋骑士（黑子）
evolution: 棋棋（黑子） Lv.26 → 棋骑士（黑子） → 棋契陛下
description: “在深夜，黑色棋子会跟在洛克身后排着队列，跟着移动。因此，在民间有洛克传言，深夜千万别碰黑色棋子，它们会把影子吃掉。实际上，那只是它们守护族人的本能而已。”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·十》
descriptionEn: At deep night, the black pieces follow behind the Rocco in a line, moving along. Thus among the folk there is a rumor: never touch the black pieces at night, they will eat shadows. In fact, that is only their instinct to protect their kind. — 'The Earth Craftsmen of the Golden Age · X'

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, responds to attacks.

skills.name: 寸拳
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; self recovers 1 energy.

skills.name: 气波
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 跺地
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 猛烈撞击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 影袭
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 提气
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+40，若敌方本回合更换精灵，额外获得威力+50。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains all-skill power +40; if enemy switches spirit this turn, additionally gains power +50.

skills.name: 鸣沙陷阱
skills.description: 造成物伤，物防比敌方越高，本次技能威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the higher one's DEF relative to the enemy, the higher this skill's power.

skills.name: 气沉丹田
skills.description: 自己回复60%生命，获得物攻+130%，每次应对后本技能能耗-3，使用后能耗重置。
skills.descriptionEn: Self recovers 60% HP, gains ATK +130%; after each response this skill's energy cost -3; after use energy cost resets.

skills.name: 破绽
skills.description: 敌方获得双防-70%，应对防御：自己额外获得物攻+70%。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains DEF&M.DEF -70%; responds to defense: self additionally gains ATK +70%.

skills.name: 岩土暴击
skills.description: 造成物伤，每被攻击1次。本技能能耗永久-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; each time attacked, this skill's energy cost permanently -1.

skills.name: 截拳
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外造成打断，回复该技能能耗的能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; responds to status: additionally causes interruption, recovers energy equal to this skill's cost.

skills.name: 地刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; responds to status: additionally interrupts the responded skill.
